item.title: Aamir Raza - SEO & Digital Marketing Expert
item.description:
About Aamir Raza

Aamir Raza is the founder and SEO strategist behind Sainik School Guide India. With over 8 years of experience in search engine optimization and digital marketing, he built this platform to bridge the information gap that exists around Sainik School admissions in India.

Background

Aamir specializes in education-sector SEO, helping students and parents find accurate, actionable information online. He noticed that most Sainik School content on the internet was either outdated, incomplete, or buried under coaching center advertisements. That realization led him to create a comprehensive, free resource that covers everything from AISSEE preparation to NDA career paths.

item.title: Nisha - Education Content Specialist
item.description:
About Nisha

Nisha has been writing about education for over 5 years, with a focus on entrance exams and school admissions. She joined Sainik School Guide India because she saw how confusing the AISSEE process was for parents, especially those from rural areas or first-generation school families.

Before this, she worked as a content writer for an ed-tech company in Jaipur, where she created study material for competitive exams. That experience taught her how to explain complex topics in simple language, which is what she does now for Sainik School content.

item.title: Rifaul Hasan - Principal, JGPS & Education Expert
item.description:
About Rifaul Hasan

Rifaul Hasan is the Principal of Jai Govind Public School (JGPS), a position he has held with distinction for over 25 years. With a quarter-century of hands-on experience in school administration, student development, and academic leadership, he brings unparalleled practical knowledge to Sainik School Guide India.

Background

As the head of JGPS, Rifaul has directly overseen the education and development of thousands of students. His 25+ years in education have given him deep insight into what works and what does not in preparing young students for competitive entrance exams like AISSEE, as well as the challenges of residential school life.

item.title: Sameer - Education Researcher
item.description:
About Sameer

Sameer is an education researcher at Sainik School Guide India. He has spent over 6 years studying how students perform in competitive entrance exams like AISSEE, and what patterns separate successful candidates from the rest.

His background is in data analysis. Before joining Sainik School Guide, he worked with coaching institutes in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, tracking student performance across multiple batches. That experience gave him a practical understanding of what works and what doesn’t in exam preparation.
